po.panelNone: No purchase order yet. Issue one to fix the price, GST, delivery address and payment terms in writing.
po.title: Purchase order {number}
po.issueIntro: A purchase order is your written order to the seller. When the seller accepts it, its payment terms become the written agreement for this order. The seller cannot change it; you send a new version if something changes.
po.paymentTermsValue: {days, plural, =0 {On delivery} one {# day after goods are accepted} other {# days after goods are accepted}}
po.msmeCovered: This seller declared itself a micro or small enterprise. Payment is due within the legal limit: at most 45 days from accepting the goods, or 15 days without a written agreement (section 15, MSMED Act; section 43B(h), Income Tax Act).
po.msmeAdvice: Accepting the purchase order is the written agreement. Paying after the limit means you can deduct the expense only in the year you actually pay.

form.addressNone: You have no saved delivery address yet.
form.terms: Payment terms (days after goods are accepted)
form.termsHint: 0 means pay on delivery. For micro and small suppliers the law allows at most 45 days.
form.amendHint: This sends a new version. The seller must accept it again. Earlier versions stay exactly as they were sent.
form.cancelHint: You cannot cancel once the seller has recorded an invoice.

invoices.title: Seller's invoices
invoices.none: The seller has not recorded an invoice yet.
invoices.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
invoices.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
invoices.dueFromInvoice: Counted from the invoice date, {date}, until you confirm delivery.
invoices.agreementWritten: Written agreement: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} allowed.
invoices.agreementNone: No written agreement (the purchase order was not accepted): 15 days.
invoices.capped: Your terms say {agreed} days; the law allows at most 45.

check.consistent: The QR matches the invoice details.
check.mismatch: The QR does not match the invoice details. Ask the seller to check it.
check.unchecked: Not checked against the e-invoice portal.

pay.title: Record a payment
pay.amountHint: Leave empty to pay the whole balance of {balance}.
pay.referenceHint: 6 to 30 letters and digits, from your bank statement.
pay.note: This records a payment you made outside the platform. Nothing is paid from here.

payables.title: Payables
payables.intro: Invoices your sellers recorded against your purchase orders, soonest due first.
payables.emptyDescription: When a seller records an invoice against one of your purchase orders it appears here with its pay-by date.
payables.disclaimer: Section 43B(h) of the Income Tax Act lets you deduct what you owe a micro or small enterprise in the year you buy only if you pay within the limit in section 15 of the MSMED Act (45 days with a written agreement, otherwise 15 days). Later payments are deductible in the year you pay. This is a reminder, not tax advice.
